en.bdb: Fame and disrepute according to the actions ,

verses.gurmukhi: ਇਕ ਵੇਚਨਿ ਹਥੀਆਰ ਘੜਿ ਇਕ ਸਵਾਰਨਿ ਸਿਲਾ ਸੰਜੋਆ।
verses.translit_en: eik vechan hatheeaar ghaR ik savaaran silaa sa(n)joaa|

en.bdb: Many a man prepare arms and sell them out and many cleanse armours.

verses.gurmukhi: ਰਣ ਵਿਚਿ ਘਾਉ ਬਚਾਉ ਕਰਿ ਦੁਇ ਦਲ ਨਿਤਿ ਉਠਿ ਕਰਦੇ ਢੋਆ।
verses.translit_en: ran vich ghaau bachaau kar dhui dhal nit uTh karadhe ddoaa|

en.bdb: In the batle the arms inflict wounds and armours protect as the warriors of both the armies clash time and again.

verses.gurmukhi: ਘਾਇਲੁ ਹੋਇ ਨੰਗਾਸਣਾ ਬਖਤਰ ਵਾਲਾ ਨਵਾਂ ਨਿਰੋਆ।
verses.translit_en: ghail hoi na(n)gaasanaa bakhatar vaalaa navaa(n) niroaa|

en.bdb: Those uncovered are wounded but those who have worn the armour remain well and intact.

verses.gurmukhi: ਕਰਨਿ ਗੁਮਾਨੁ ਕਮਾਨਗਰ ਖਾਨਜਰਾਦੀ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਬਖੋਆ।
verses.translit_en: karan gumaan kamaanagar khaanajaraadhee bahut bakhoaa|

en.bdb: Bow makers also feel proud of their special bows.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜਗ ਵਿਚਿ ਸਾਧ ਅਸਾਧ ਸੰਗੁ ਸੰਗ ਸੁਭਾਇ ਜਾਇ ਫਲੁ ਭੋਆ।
verses.translit_en: jag vich saadh asaadh sa(n)g sa(n)g subhai jai fal bhoaa|

en.bdb: Two types of associations, one of the sadhus and the other of the wicked ones are there in this world and meeting them different results are produced.

verses.gurmukhi: ਕਰਮ ਸੁ ਧਰਮ ਅਧਰਮ ਕਰਿ ਸੁਖ ਦੁਖ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਆਇ ਪਰੋਆ।
verses.translit_en: karam su dharam adharam kar sukh dhukh a(n)dhar aai paroaa|

en.bdb: That is why, the individual because of his good and bad conduct remains absorbed in his pleasures or sufferings.
The good and bad receive fame and infamy respectively.
